## Release — backlog-campaign v0.23.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.23.0

Minor release focused on running accurately wherever a campaign runs: a local
Claude Code or Cursor session, a cloud session that is wiped when it ends, or a
Claude Project thread. Each run now works out what it can do, then routes the
campaign from that instead of assuming a logged-in local machine.

#### Run context (ADR-046, ADR-050)

- **Each run resolves what it can do** before routing: how it reaches GitHub,
  how it asks you a question, how it waits on CI, and whether its disk outlives
  the session. The result is written to `.blackhole/run-context.json` and
  re-read on every resume.
- **Claude Project threads get their own mode.** Questions go to decision cards,
  CI is awaited through PR events instead of polling, and recurring work is
  scheduled as a routine.
- **`scripts/ci-verdict.ts`** turns a PR's checks into green, red or pending
  with a stable exit code, so the merge gate reads the same verdict whether the
  checks came from a live call or a PR event.

#### GitHub without a CLI login (ADR-048)

- **Every script calls GitHub over REST** through `gh api`, so status, sync and
  deferred-finding triage work in cloud sessions where `gh auth status` fails
  but a token is set.
- A channel table maps each forge step in the playbooks to its CLI, REST and
  GitHub MCP form, so an agent with only MCP tools can still follow them.

#### State that survives an ephemeral machine (ADR-049)

- **Campaign state is kept on a `blackhole/state` branch** when the run context
  marks the machine as ephemeral: pushed at each turn end, restored on resume.
  Your working tree, index and checked-out branch are never touched.
- A resume refuses to overwrite local state that differs from the branch unless
  forced, since the disk may hold newer state than the last push.

#### Hooks that stay out of ordinary sessions (ADR-047)

- **Worktree containment and the main-clone guard apply only to campaign
  workers**, or to a session that opts in with `BLACKHOLE_HOOK_SCOPE=all`.
  Ordinary sessions in a repo with blackhole installed are no longer blocked.

#### Install and plugin bundle

- **The Claude plugin bundle resolves from the installed plugin cache**, so a
  marketplace install works without a repo checkout.
- Cloud agents install Mercure and Blackhole straight from GitHub.

#### Reliability

- CI jobs on the shared runner are time-bounded, and the test suite uses a
  deadlock guard instead of a tight per-test budget.
- Promoted review artifacts and the frontmatter check now require a `summary`,
  matching the generated documentation index.
- New tests make the hook tier limit, state-write guard refusals and
  design-track verdicts falsifiable.
